ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Fire Ecology
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The generic engine half of FIRE_ECOLOGY_LOOP_1 — a self-igniting desert-savanna fire ecology any Star Wars desert scenario could use unchanged: a scorchable-ground → ash-ladder terrain chain (trace → light → heavy → deep, real pathCost/fertility teeth, triggered by vanilla's own TerrainDef.burnedDef on flammable ground), a Black Rain WeatherDef that exploits vanilla's existing FireWatcher.LargeFireDangerPresent / WeatherDecider.ChanceFactorRainOnFire mechanism to follow and extinguish a large fire, fire-triggered scorch-fruit and fulgurites (one narrow Harmony hook: strike/burn-spawns-prop), and a salvaged firefoam sprayer + buildable firebreak strip.
Campaign-specific wiring (which biome carries this, at what numbers) lives in RimUtinni: Fire Ecology (`mandrake.rut.fireecology`), which patches it onto the Pyrelands. This mod carries no Ash'karr/clan/story references — see `design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`'s engine/content split.
No creatures, no pyroconvective cell, no Tribes burn behavior — that's the rest of `design/Jawa/proposals/fire_ecology_deep_design.md`, awaiting PROPOSAL_SUITE_REVIEW_1.
